name: Lingering Cold
source:
Just before Christmas, you’re sent away on yet another business trip. It was meant to be routine, just another task.

But as night descends, unsettling events unfold – things you never imagined possible.

[From [url=https://maplegame31.itch.io/lingering-cold]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
圣诞节前夕，你又被派去出差。这本来就是例行公事，只是另一项任务。

但随着夜幕降临，令人不安的事件发生了——这是你从未想象过的事情。

[来自[url=https://maplegame31.itch.io/lingering-cold]Itch.io[/url]]
